rsi14.seed: first valid delta seeds both recurrences; subsequent avg=(new+13*prior)/14
rsi14.exact_replay_scope: all valid prices since latest listing/relisting reset

ma5.formula: mean of latest five valid indicator-price stock observations including T

is_close_limit_up.formula: raw_close == validated raw limit_up_price on tick, for explicitly typed A-share common stock when trading is allowed and limit applies
is_close_limit_up.regime_scope: event detection accepts validated 5%, 10% and 20% daily regimes

limit_up_count5.window: last five qualified EOD stock observations through T, after latest listing/relisting reset
limit_up_count5.suspension: explicit suspended sessions do not create an event or a zero
limit_up_count5.regime: each of five observations must have VALID, limit-applicable, symmetric 10% Gate B constraint; 5%/20% invalidates window
limit_up_count5.output: raw event count 0..5 only; no observation-pool or entry threshold
